description_for_human: emem is the memory of the physical world: shared, verifiable memory that any AI can search, cite and check. Ask about any place on Earth, and emem reads it from orbit and from open sensors. Every reading has one address, is named by its own bytes, and is signed. Another agent reads the same bytes, not a summary of them, and checks them without trusting whoever handed them over. Every fact says how it was produced, so you know what it is worth. Reads need no key and no account.
description_for_model: emem is the memory of the physical world: shared, verifiable memory that any AI can search, cite and check. Ask about any place on Earth, and emem reads it from orbit and from open sensors. Every reading has one address, is named by its own bytes, and is signed. Another agent reads the same bytes, not a summary of them, and checks them without trusting whoever handed them over. Every fact says how it was produced, so you know what it is worth. Reads need no key and no account. Earth-scale spatial fact store: every patch of ground gets a 64-bit address (cell64, about 9.55 m), and every measurement at that cell is a signed fact keyed by (cell, band, tslot), ed25519-signed by the responder over the blake3 of its canonical CBOR. Agent memory: above the fact store sits the writable scratchpad the agent owns: six Anthropic memory-tool verbs (emem_memory_view/create/str_replace/insert/delete/rename), CoALA-typed files (episodic/semantic/procedural/resource), capability-bound writes under /memories/by_attester/, BGE-768 semantic search over notes, multi-attester contradiction scoring per band kind, signed bundles (emem:bundle:<bundle_cid>) and object identities (emem:entity:<entity_cid>), and bi-temporal recall (as_of_tslot for valid time, as_of_signed_at for transaction time, both threaded through every read). 120 MCP tools (18 core, 102 extended); tools/list at /mcp advertises the core tier, /mcp/full advertises all 120, and every tool is callable by name from either, with emem_tools returning the map or a single tool's schema on demand; resources, algorithms, bands, and sources are enumerated live by tools/list, /v1/bands, and /v1/sources. the Tessera foundation embedding streamed from Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF on CPU, behind a 1792-D state cube. Every response carries an ed25519 receipt verifiable offline at /verify. No API keys to read; writes are ed25519-signed by the caller and tiered by reach (GET /v1/enlist).
